title: How Does Kodak Make Film? (Kodak Factory Tour Part 1 of 3) - Smarter Every Day 271
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day tours a Kodak factory to show how photographic film is manufactured. This is part one of a three-part series covering the large-scale coating and production process.
why: HN viewers find the film manufacturing process and the engineering behind it fascinating, especially the continuous roll changes.

quote.text: it’s a fascinating look at the process of film manufacturing
